newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Bids slip on exports.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Bids slip on exports.

text.p: Dark northern spring wheat bids were mostly lower again Tuesday as prices fell in response to slack exports and no movement, grain dealers said.
"There's just nothing going on," one North Dakota-based dealer said. "It's real slow, and there's no movement."
Cash sources continued to lament the absence of an export market. Most export business is expected to continue to go to competitors with more attractively priced wheat.
Demand from domestic millers was also said to be slowing because most have covered their near-term needs, a cash source said.
However, that demand should return to the market in several weeks as millers work through supplies, the source said.
